text: As a result of the loss of parking on Colborne Street and the lack of commercial loading opportunities in this area, the Old Town Toronto Business Improvement Area (BIA), in consultation with the local Councillor and Transportation Services’ staff, requested that commercial loading zones be established at the following locations: - Church Street, west side, between Colborne Street and a point 29 metres south - Wellington Street East, north side, between a point 42.5 metres east of Scott Street and Leader Lane These requests are feasible and will help facilitate loading and unloading operations for businesses in this area. It is noted that a commercial loading zone is a public facility, which may be used by anyone for the purpose of and while engaged in loading or unloading of merchandise and no one has exclusive rights to the loading zone.

City Council on July 29 and 30, 2026, adopted the following: 1. City Council amend the existing parking machine regulation in effect from 9:30 a.m. to 3:30 p.m., Monday to Friday, from 8:00 a.m. to 9:00 p.m. Saturday and from 1:00 p.m. to 9:00 p.m. Sunday, at a rate of $7.00 per hour and for a maximum period of three hours, on the west side of Church Street, between Front Street East and King Street East, to be in effect between Colborne Street and King Street East. 2. City Council amend the existing parking machine regulation in effect from 6:30 p.m. to 9:00 p.m., Monday to Friday, at a rate of $7.00 per hour and for a maximum period of two and half hours, on the west side of Church Street, between Front Street East and King Street East, to be in effect between Colborne Street and King Street East. 3.
